summary: Family sheet-metal shop (70 staff, EUR 7.5 M). We are 11.3 % of its turnover; it is our sole source for base frame HN 50/65 (our tooling, no second source). Quality is collapsing: red scorecard three quarters running, OTD 63 %, 4118 ppm, escalation letter sent 24 Sep. It asked +2-4 % in 2024/25 and settled at 0. Open deep, lead with scorecard and cost recovery, then index and forecast.
notes: Needs our volume (11 % of turnover); asked for 10-day payment against a cash discount (generic e-mail, no distress: credit index flat 232). Fears losing the frame after the red escalation. No should-cost and no second source: our walk-away rests on owning the tooling. We pay 6 days late on average, no complaint yet.
fears: losing the frame after the red escalation
